title: First game published!
author: Both_Lawfulness6708
selftext:
Now, mind you  I have like 6 projects unfinished. 1 has been my primary focus and it's going through an art overhaul now.

But, I had wanted to finish a program, so I made a very simple "Educational wagon survival game" and applied to Google play store to be able to publish.

It took a while to get my ID verified due to a mix of blurry images and me forgetting about it and puttng it off.

So, when I got it all done the other day, I had this game finished and uploaded it. But it was SOO artistically slapped together to just say I jad a finished game.

So, I spent like a day and a half upgrading all the visual art, adding 9 background songs and a bunch of art that wasn't neccesary, but IMHO polishes the game well.

I played through it, it was very quick and too easy and while relaxing, was kind of boring.

I also added some mini games and released it as V1.1

It's officially published, but will be private for like 2 weeks while it's playtested.

I've already began enriching it as a premium alternative.

Route variation, multiple collection compendiums, added NPCs, puzzles, souvenirs and new events.

Regardless, I'm just happy to have an officially published game up on the play store.

May release it soon on Itch.io as well, maybe a few other places.

I made a quick gameplay video on it as well.

Ps. I la led the flair self promotion, but, for real, I just wanted to tell some more people I got something published, it's not really complete, because I keep.adding and tweaking it though.

replies.author: Both_Lawfulness6708
replies.body:
It has several diseases you can contract based on random events and and invisible health threshold..

It was a glitch I fixed from version 1.1, it will be adjusted in v 1.2

Health was increasing 1.5 units per travel, it was supposed to be trending down wards.
